question: What is the first testable incremental evaluation boundary?
decision: Use a blank-line-delimited source transcript that is compiled by the production C++ compiler and replayed by the Rust VM; commit only successful forms and expose only the new stdout suffix.

session.submission: blank line commits the pending source form
session.state: accepted source transcript plus accepted VM stdout
session.failure: parse, type, bytecode, and runtime failures do not commit the candidate

compatibility_boundary.runtime: source-backed deterministic replay; no in-process VM state yet
compatibility_boundary.diagnostics: temporary session paths render as <repl> when present; pathless frontend diagnostics retain their existing format
compatibility_boundary.output: only a successful replay suffix is emitted
compatibility_boundary.ids: existing source-local and snapshot-local IDs remain outside the transcript

quantitative_gate: tests/repl_tests.py covers persistence, compile/runtime rollback, reset, multiline forms, and diagnostic normalization.
